entries.scope: Restrict credential-bearing settings files to their owning Unix account while preserving atomic replacement and Windows behavior
entries.rationale: DE: Die Änderung schließt ein lokales Credential-Leserisiko und benötigt einen nachvollziehbaren plattformspezifischen Sicherheitsnachweis. EN: The change closes a local credential-read risk and needs traceable platform-specific security evidence.
entries.navigationImpact: No navigation change; the existing secure-development gate register remains authoritative.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized CEFR-B2 evidence text.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Unix-focused tests assert exact 0600 permissions after initial creation, replacement, and read-time migration of legacy-readable files; they also verify stale settings-temp cleanup and rejection of group-writable directories. Windows CI preserves the existing write and round-trip behavior without Unix APIs. The current NuGet vulnerability output is retained as separate follow-up evidence rather than being misreported as green.
entries.risk: High if temporary or final settings files expose database credentials to other local users.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Settings storage paths, serialization formats, Unix deployment identities, Windows ACL requirements, or atomic-write behavior change.
